scripts.text:
[Elin]
^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
^3355FF等一下！你现在携带的物品太多了。请先将一些物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hello~!
Heh heh, you're a boy, so you probably don't like dolls, right? Well, I like dolls very very much!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你好呀~！
嘿嘿，你是男孩子，大概不喜欢娃娃吧？不过我超级超级喜欢娃娃！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hi hi~! Oh, oh, do you like dolls? I really really like dolls... Hee Hee~!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗨嗨~！哦，哦，你喜欢娃娃吗？我真的超级超级喜欢娃娃...嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
You know, I really really want a new doll! I hope my daddy will give me one on my birthday...!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你知道吗，我真的很想要一个新娃娃！希望爸爸会在生日那天送我一个...！

scripts.text: Um, I hope your daddy gives you one too.
scripts.translation: 嗯，希望爸爸也送你一个。

scripts.text: How about I give you one now?
scripts.translation: 要不我现在就送你一个？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Yeah, I'm hoping
he gives me a Yoyo
doll. They're so cute!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
对，我希望
他送我一只
溜溜猴娃娃。
它们好可爱！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Maybe you should put some of your stuff away first, you look like you're carrying too much, hee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
也许你应该先把一些东西收起来，看起来你携带的东西太多了，嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Do you always carry so much with you? Put some of your things away first, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你总是携带这么多东西吗？先把一些东西收起来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Oh my goodness!
Really? You're
such a sweetie~!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
天哪！
真的吗？
你真好~！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Will you really?
You're gonna give
me a doll? Yaaaay~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
真的吗？
你要送我
一个娃娃？耶~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
What kind of doll are you going to give me? Are you really gonna give me one?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你要送我什么娃娃？你真的要送我一个吗？

scripts.text: Poring Doll
scripts.translation: 波利娃娃

scripts.text: Chonchon Doll
scripts.translation: 苍蝇娃娃

scripts.text: Puppet
scripts.translation: 木偶

scripts.text: Rocker Doll
scripts.translation: 摇滚蝗虫娃娃

scripts.text: Spore Doll
scripts.translation: 魔菇娃娃

scripts.text: Osiris Doll
scripts.translation: 俄塞里斯娃娃

scripts.text: Baphomet Doll
scripts.translation: 巴风特娃娃

scripts.text: Raccoon Doll
scripts.translation: 浣熊娃娃

scripts.text: Yoyo Doll
scripts.translation: 溜溜猴娃娃

scripts.text: I'm as adorable as a doll.
scripts.translation: 我像娃娃一样可爱。

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Aww...
I have a lot
of Poring dolls...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎呀...
我有好多波利娃娃...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
But since a cute boy is giving it to me, I'll happily take it! Hee hee, soft and fluffy Poring doll~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
不过既然可爱的男孩送给我，我就开心地收下啦！嘻嘻，软绵绵的波利娃娃~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
But since a nice girl is giving it to me, I'll take it! Hee he, soft and fluffy Poring doll~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
不过既然漂亮的女孩送给我，我就收下啦！嘻嘻，软绵绵的波利娃娃~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Ooh, let me give you something as a little thank you. You see, I hid some candy so I can eat it without telling mommy.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哦，让我给你点东西作为小小的感谢。你看，我藏了一些糖果，这样我就可以偷偷吃，不用告诉妈妈了。

scripts.text:
[Elin]
I don't know if you're too old to like candy, but I guess it's okay.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我不知道你是不是年纪太大不喜欢糖果了，不过应该没关系吧。

scripts.text:
[Elin]
So, try not to eat too much, okay? Otherwise, you might get in trouble!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
所以，尽量别吃太多，好吗？不然可能会惹上麻烦的！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Thank you
so much for
the Poring doll!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
非常感谢
你送的波利娃娃！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Aww...?
Were you only teasing me?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎呀...？
你只是在逗我玩吗？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Aww...
You're not making fun of me are you?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎呀...
你是在捉弄我吧？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
I guess you forgot it somewhere...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我想你是把它忘在什么地方了吧...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Agh--!
A Ch-Ch, Chonchon doll?!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
啊--！
一一只苍蝇娃娃？！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
But since... You're... Such a nice guy... I better take it...!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
但是既然...你...是个好人...我还是收下吧...！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
But since... Since it's a gift... I guess I'll take it...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
但是既然...既然是礼物...我就收下吧...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Mmm~
Let me give you
something in return...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗯~
让我给你点东西作为回礼...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
If you eat too much, your teeth will start to rot... at least, that's what Mommy says.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
吃太多的话牙齿会烂掉的...至少妈妈是这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Elin]
And..
Uh...
Thank you
for the doll?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
还有..
那个...
谢谢
你的娃娃？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Chonchon dolls are ugly anyways, but you still lied to me! How can you be so mean?!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
苍蝇娃娃本来就丑，但你居然骗我！你怎么能这么坏？！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Waaaaaaaaah~~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哇啊啊啊~~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Wow...!
It looks like a bunny!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哇...！
看起来像只兔子！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
I really like this Puppet~ Heh hehe! Thank you so much~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我真的很喜欢这个布偶~ 嘿嘿！太感谢你了~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Ooh ooh!
I have something
for you too!
Um, where
did it... Ah!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哦哦！
我也有东西
要给你！
嗯，放在哪
了...啊！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Here it is! It's some of the candy Santa gave me. Go ahead and try some! Oh, and thank you so much for the doll!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
找到了！这是圣诞老人给我的糖果。快尝尝吧！哦，还有，非常感谢你送我的娃娃！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Awww, you were only kidding? W-W-Why are you teasing me like that?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎呀，你只是开玩笑？为...为什么你要这样捉弄我？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Waaaaaaaaah~~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哇啊啊啊~~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Ooh! Rocker Doll!
It's the Rocker that likes singing and dancing! I don't like grasshoppers, but I like this because it's cute~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哦！摇滚蝗虫娃娃！
就是那个喜欢唱歌跳舞的蝗虫！我不喜欢蝗虫，但我觉得这个很可爱~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hmmm, I should give you something too, huh? Let's see, I have what my grandpa gave me...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗯嗯，我也应该给你点东西，对吧？让我看看，我有爷爷给我的...东西...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Here you go! We have a lot of this at home, so I'll give it to you, okay? Oh, and thank you so much for the doll~ I love cute dolls!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
给你！家里有很多这个，所以给你一些，好吗？哦，还有，非常感谢你送我的娃娃~ 我喜欢可爱的娃娃！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Awww...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
You don't
really have a doll...?
I was so excited about it, too...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你其实
没有娃娃...？
我也很期待呢...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
It's a mushroom?
Ewwwwwwwww, yucky!
Mommy made me eat
mushrooms today, too...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
是蘑菇？
呕，好恶心！
妈妈今天也逼我吃蘑菇了...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
But this doll is cute, so I'll take it. But I'm still not gonna eat mushrooms! Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
不过这个娃娃很可爱，我就收下吧。但我还是不吃蘑菇！嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hehe~ My mommy made this! It's really yummy. I love cookies, too. So try it, you'll like it! Hee hee!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿嘿~ 这是我妈妈做的！真的很好吃。我也喜欢饼干。快尝尝，你会喜欢的！嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Thanks for
the doll! I'll
take good care of it!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
谢谢
你的娃娃！我会
好好照顾它的！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Eh...?
You don't
have a doll?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
诶...？
你没有
娃娃？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Awww...
It's not nice
to tease people
like that. ^666666*Sniff, sniff*^000000
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎呀...
这样捉弄人
是不对的。^666666*吸鼻子，吸鼻子*^000000

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Ahhhhh!
What is this
thing?! It's so scary!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
啊啊啊！
这是什么
东西？！好可怕！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
I've never seen a doll like this before. Where it's from? Hmm? Since I've never seen this kind of doll before, I'm gonna show it to my daddy, too. Hehe~! He'll be surprised!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我从没见过这样的娃娃。它是从哪里来的？嗯？既然我从没见过这种娃娃，我要把它给爸爸看看。嘿嘿~！他一定会很惊讶的！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Here, since you gave me such a nicely made doll, I better give you something good too.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
给你，既然你送了我这么精致的娃娃，我也应该给你点好东西。

scripts.text:
[Elin]
I found it when I secretly went to the forest. I took it because it has pretty colors!
Since there's two, you can share it with your girlfriend. Hee hee~!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
这是我偷偷去普勒斯特森林时找到的。因为颜色很漂亮，我就拿回来了！
既然有两个，你可以和你的女朋友分享哦。嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
I found it when I secretly went to the forest. I took it because it has pretty colors!
Since there's two, you can share it with your boyfriend. Hee hee~!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
这是我偷偷去普勒斯特森林时找到的。因为颜色很漂亮，我就拿回来了！
既然有两个，你可以和你的男朋友分享哦。嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Awww...
Why do you have
to make fun of me?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎呀...
为什么要
捉弄我呀？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Huh?
It's a little goat...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
咦？
是一只小山羊...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
It's so weird. It's cute but it's also scary at the same time. Well, since you gave me a pretty doll, I wanna give you something, too.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
好奇怪。虽然很可爱，但同时也让人有点害怕。不过，既然你送了我这么漂亮的娃娃，我也想送你点东西。

scripts.text:
[Elin]
My daddy gave me this when I was really sick. I'm not sick anymore so you can use it when you need to. Hehehe~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
这是我生病时爸爸给我的。我现在已经好了，所以你需要的时候可以用。嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hee hee~
Thank you for
the doll. I won't lose it!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿嘿~
谢谢你的娃娃。
我不会弄丢它的！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
You big liar! Why are you pretending to be nice?!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你这个大骗子！为什么要假装对我好？！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hehe, it's a
raccoon doll.
It's very very cute~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿嘿，这是一个
狸猫娃娃。
非常非常可爱~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
I don't like
Smokies in real life,
but this doll is nice!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我不喜欢
现实中的狸猫，
但这个娃娃很不错！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Here, let me give you some cake my grandma made. It's really yummy. I don't know if you like sweets or not, but it's really good! Please try some!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
给你，尝尝我老奶奶做的蛋糕。真的很好吃。我不知道你喜不喜欢甜食，但它真的很好吃！请尝尝吧！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hee hee~
Thanks for the doll.
I'm gonna keep it
in my room!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿嘿~
谢谢你的娃娃。
我要把它
放在我的房间里！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hey! How come you have to say things like that? Are you making fun of me?!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿！
为什么你要说这种话？你是在捉弄我吗？！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Woooooooow~!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哇哦哦哦哦~！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
A Yoyo doll! It's so pretty! You're really gonna give it to me?! Yay! Thank you so much! I really like it! Hee hee!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
溜溜猴娃娃！好漂亮！你真的要给我吗？！太好了！非常感谢！我真的好喜欢！嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Since you gave
me such a pretty doll,
I wanna give you
something, too!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
既然你送了我
这么漂亮的娃娃，
我也想送你
点东西！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
My daddy picked it up on his way to another town. It looks like some kind of seed. I tried planting it in front of our house but it won't grow. Do you want to try?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
这是爸爸去别的城镇路上捡到的。看起来像某种种子。我试着把它种在我们家门前，但它长不出来。你想试试吗？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hehe~
Thanks for
the doll. I'll hug
it before I go
to sleep!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿嘿~
谢谢你的娃娃。
我睡觉前
会抱着它的！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hey...
How come you're making fun of me?!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿...
为什么你要捉弄我？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm as adorable as a doll...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我像娃娃一样可爱...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Whaaaaaaaaaaat...?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哇啊啊啊...？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
^3355FFWhat did^000000
^3355FFyou just say?!^000000

[Grampa]
*Gasp*...
....*Gasp!*
Oh...
Some may say I've lived a full life on wine, women and song...
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
*倒吸一口凉气*...
....*喘气！*
噢...
也许有人会说，我这一生都在美酒、女人和歌声中度过...

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
But my soul still burns with youthful vigor! It's just... This old body can't keep up anymore... *Hack! Wheeeeze~*
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
但我的灵魂依然燃烧着年轻的活力！只是...这副老骨头再也跟不上了... *咳！呼哧~*

scripts.text: Show him Tiger's Footskin.
scripts.translation: 给他看虎掌。

scripts.text: Exchange it with Boys Cap.
scripts.translation: 用男孩的帽子交换。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
Ohhh~ !!
Is that...?
It is! 
That's Tiger's Footskin!! Even from here I can feel its powers!
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
噢噢~！！
那是...？
没错！
那是虎掌！！即使从这里我也能感受到它的力量！

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
One glance at it can restore your strength, one sniff and your blood boils with vigorous pleasure...
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
看一眼就能恢复体力，闻一下就会热血沸腾，充满活力的快感...

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
Just one bite...
Will revive my virility!!!! The Tiger's Footskin~!! Ohhhh! Ohh My God !! Please!!! Please give me that... Please...
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
只要咬一口...
就能让我重振雄风！！虎掌~！！噢噢！天哪！！求求您了！！请给我那个...求求您...

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
T... Thank you !!
With this I can revive my youthful splendor!! I must eat this thing right away !
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
谢...谢谢您！！
有了这个，我就能重现年轻时的风采了！我必须马上吃掉它！

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
...
Nope. Still feel OLD.
If anything, I feel even worse. Th-there's this buzzing in my head...
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
...
不行。还是觉得老。
如果说有什么不同的话，我感觉更糟了。头...头里嗡嗡作响...

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
He...Hey, kid !! W-Wait !
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
嘿...嘿，小孩！！等...等等！

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
Listen well...
You've got to take care of yourself as well as your can. Without your health, one cannot enjoy the pleasures of this mortal realm.
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
听好了...
你要尽可能照顾好自己。没有健康，就无法享受这凡尘世间的乐趣。

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
In order to restore my youth, I tried all sorts of things, mostly by hearsay, but nothing worked. In the end, I spent so much zeny on miracle cures, I ended up broke.
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
为了恢复青春，我尝试了各种各样的东西，大多是听别人说的，但都没用。最后，我花光了所有的Zeny去买那些灵丹妙药，结果破产了。

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
I've mostly given up on restoring my youth. But there is one hope left... Eating ^3355FFTiger's Footskin^000000, The King of Invigorators!!
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
我基本上已经放弃恢复青春了。但还剩下一丝希望...吃^3355FF虎掌^000000，活力之王！！

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
Haven't you heard?! One glance would restore the color in my white hair, one sniff, even just one touch, and an 80 year-old would have another chance at youth... It's The King of Invigorators !
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
你没听说过吗？！看一眼就能让我白发变黑，闻一下，甚至只要碰一下，一个80岁的人就能重获青春...它是活力之王！

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
Before I die...
I wish I could eat 10 Tiger's Footskin. Then, I wouldn't have to die!
scripts.translation:
[爷爷]
在我死之前...
我希望我能吃掉10个虎掌。那样，我就不必死了！

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
If someone helped me get them, I would give that person my precious item, ^3355FFBoys Cap^000000 without regret...

Well, the hats I have with me are for my customers. If I use them for myself, I'll have nothing to sell...
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
嗯，我手边的帽子是卖给顾客的。如果我自己用了，就没什么可卖的了...

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
I want to make something special for you because you showed me such kindness, but I don't have anything like that right now.
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
因为您对我这么好，我想为您做点特别的东西，但我现在手头没有合适的材料。

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
Hmm...
I think I can make a special item from the items you already have.
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
嗯...
我觉得可以用您现有的材料制作一件特别的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
If there are any forged items or slotted items with monster cards, then put them into your Kafra storage.
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
如果您有锻造过的物品，或者镶嵌了魔物卡片的物品，请把它们存入卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
Heh heh...
I think I'll make you a Hat of the Sun God~
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
嘿嘿...
我想为您制作一顶太阳神头盔~

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
See! Here it is!!
Haha, I made this quicker than the speed of light!
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
看！在这里！！
哈哈，我做得比光速瞬移还快呢！

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
...Or maybe I just gave you the one I already had, and took your items. Hee hee!
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
...或者我只是把早就做好的给您，然后拿走了您的材料。嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
Anyway, I justed want to give something really nice to you...
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
总之，我只是想送您一份很棒的礼物...

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
Hmm...
^0000FF1 Emblem of the Sun God^000000
^0000FF10 Gold^000000
^0000FF40 Steel^000000
^0000FF50 Coal^000000
^0000FF2 Oridecon^000000

[Tempestra]
If you have these, I can make you my fantastic 'Hat of the Sun God!'
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
如果您有这些材料，我就能为您制作出我引以为傲的“太阳神头盔”！

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
I just want to make something really special for you, so I won't charge you any zeny to make this hat.
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
我只是想为您做点特别的东西，所以制作这顶帽子不收您任何Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
Umm, I appreciate it but, I guess you just ran out of Yellow Potions?
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
嗯，我很感激，不过...您是不是黄色药水用完了？

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
....How rude!
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
....真没礼貌！

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
What does a man have to do to get a stiff drink around here? I mean, there are absolutely no good bars in Alberta!
scripts.translation:
[金赛]
一个男人要怎么做才能在这里喝到烈酒呢？我是说，艾尔贝塔这里根本没有像样的酒吧！

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
Well, the alcohol in the pub here is second rate, but I gotta admit, it's got a great atmosphere.
scripts.translation:
[金赛]
嗯，这里的酒馆虽然酒质一般，但我不得不承认，这里的氛围很棒。

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
In fact, this old man is always there, telling stories about Turtle Island! But we're not sure if he's been there, or if he's just that drunk.
scripts.translation:
[金赛]
事实上，那位老人总是坐在那里，讲着关于海龟岛的故事！但我们不确定他是否真的去过那里，还是只是喝得太醉了。

scripts.text: Sounds fun~
scripts.translation: 听起来很有趣~

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
Whoa...
Hey, your eyes just lit up right when I said 'Turtle Island!' Hmm, let me try that again.
scripts.translation:
[金赛]
哇...
嘿，我一提到“海龟岛”，您的眼睛就亮了起来。嗯，让我再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
*Ahem*
'Tur-tle
Is-land.'
scripts.translation:
[金赛]
*咳咳*
“海-龟-岛。”

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
Ah...
You must be an adventurer. It seems like you really wanna learn more about that place, huh?
scripts.translation:
[金赛]
啊...
您一定是位冒险者。看来您真的很想多了解那个地方，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
Why don't you look around near the pub, and look for that old man? He's usually pretty drunk, and speaks nonsense, but he might have something to say to you.
scripts.translation:
[金赛]
您不妨去酒馆附近转转，找找那位老人。他通常喝得烂醉，说话颠三倒四，但也许对您有些话要说。

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
Oh, and um, I've been in his room before. He leaves some sort of letter lying around the table that has something to do with his Turtle Island stories.
scripts.translation:
[金赛]
哦，对了，我之前去过他的房间。他在桌子上留了一封信，似乎与他关于海龟岛的故事有关。

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
But if he asks for you to buy him a drink, I wouldn't do it. He's got like, three extra livers or something, so he'll drink you to bankruptcy.
scripts.translation:
[金赛]
但如果他让您请他喝酒，我劝您别答应。他好像有三颗额外的肝脏，能把您喝到破产。

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
Yeah, I guess it's pretty cool listening to his stories. But it would be even cooler if I could hear them in a better drinking establishment.
scripts.translation:
[金赛]
嗯，听他讲故事确实挺有意思的。但如果能在一家更好的酒馆里听，那就更棒了。

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
I mean, they don't even serve a 'Boogieman,' much less a 'Cobo.' It's getting harder and harder to find those fine, fine specialty drinks.
scripts.translation:
[金赛]
我是说，他们连“鬼魂”都不卖，更别提“科博”了。那些精致的高级饮品越来越难找了。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Ooog...
So dizzy...
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
噢...
好晕...

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
There isn't one decent drinking establishment in all of Alberta! But then again, why did I drink so much? Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
整个艾尔贝塔竟然没有一家像样的酒馆！不过话说回来，我为什么喝那么多呢？嗯...

scripts.text: Tell me about Turtle Island
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于海龟岛的事

scripts.text: How can I get there?
scripts.translation: 我怎么去那里？

scripts.text: Stop talking
scripts.translation: 别说了

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Eh...?
Turtle Island?
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
呃...？
海龟岛？

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Well, there's a lot of folklore about that place. Some folk say that there's a mountain of treasure there.
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
嗯，关于那个地方有很多传说。有人说那里有一座宝藏山。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Others folk say a potion that can prolong your lifespan can be found somewhere in Turtle Island. But nobody really knows for sure.
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
还有人说，在海龟岛的某个地方能找到一种能延长寿命的药水。但没人能确定。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
But I'm sure that Turtle Island does exist, and that something wonderful can be found there.
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
但我确信海龟岛是真实存在的，而且那里一定藏着美好的事物。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
But only someone with a good heart that's eager for adventure should be able to go to that kind of place.
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
不过，只有心地善良且渴望冒险的人，才能前往那样的地方。

scripts.text: Tell me more, old man!
scripts.translation: 老家伙，再多说点！

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Ha ha ha~!
I like the shine in your eye, my boy! I can see a little bit of myself in those eyes. Yes...
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
哈哈~！
我喜欢你眼中的光芒，孩子！我在你眼中看到了年轻时的自己。是的...

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Ha ha ha~!
No use hiding the glint in your eyes, my dear! It's adventure you wish for, that much I can tell...
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
哈哈~！
别想掩饰你眼中的光芒，亲爱的！你渴望冒险，这一点我看得出来...

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Tell me...
Have you heard of a man named ^3355FFJornadan Niliria^000000? He, and a group of ten other men actually found Turtle Island!
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
告诉我...
你听说过一位名叫^3355FF约尔纳丹·尼利里亚^000000的人吗？他和另外十个人一起发现了海龟岛！

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
^3355FFJornadan Niliria^000000 was a man of strength and conviction. He and his crew gathered every clue they could about Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
^3355FF约尔纳丹·尼利里亚^000000是一位充满力量与信念的人。他和他的船员收集了所有关于海龟岛的线索。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Even after learning all that they could, much of their voyage relied on their hope and faith that the Turtle Island legend was true...
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
即使掌握了所有能找到的信息，他们的航行依然依赖于对海龟岛传说真实的希望与信任...

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
After a long, arduous journey, their efforts were rewarded, and they landed on Turtle Island!
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
经过漫长而艰辛的旅程，他们的努力终于得到了回报，他们登上了海龟岛！

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
However, it gets more complicated after that. I hear Niliria's crew had great difficulty getting back home for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
不过，之后的事情就变得复杂了。我听说尼利里亚的船员因为某种原因，很难回到家乡。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Heh heh...
If you want to learn more, why don't you go to the eastern end of the Alberta port? There's a scholar there that knows more of this story.
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
嘿嘿...
如果你想了解更多，不妨去艾尔贝塔港的东边看看。那里有一位学者，他更了解这个故事。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
He could probably shed more light on the subject of Turtle Island's legend.
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
他应该能为你解开海龟岛传说的更多谜团。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Ah, one more thing! Look around that scholar and you should find his ^3355FFJournal^000000. I promise that it will be an interesting read.
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
啊，还有一件事！在那位学者身边找找，你应该能找到他的^3355FF日记^000000。我保证，那会是一本很有趣的书。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Ah...
The fire of youth!
When the winds die, may your dreams fill your sails~ Good luck to you!
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
啊...
青春之火啊！
当风停息时，愿你的梦想填满你的风帆~ 祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Grrrr...!
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
嘎嘎嘎...！

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
I may not know much, but I won't talk to anyone motivated solely by greed. Go home!
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
我虽然知道得不多，但我不会跟那些只被贪婪驱动的人说话。回家去吧！

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Well...
If you go to eastern side of the Alberta port, you should find an old ferryboatman.
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
嗯...
如果你去艾尔贝塔港的东边，应该能找到一位老船夫。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
His name is ^3355FFGotanblue^000000. I believe he may know a way to Turtle Island. Heh heh, good luck~
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
他叫^3355FF戈坦布鲁^000000。我相信他可能知道去海龟岛的路。嘿嘿，祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Turtle Island...?
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
海龟岛...？

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
My, that place is difficult to find and even more difficult to travel to. You're sure you want to go? I would love to give you some advice, but I feel so dizzy after drinking so much...
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
哎呀，那个地方很难找到，更难到达。你确定要去吗？我很想给你一些建议，但喝了这么多酒，我感觉好晕啊...

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Ho ho ho...
Why don't you talk to a chubby little sailor I know named ^3355FFGotanblue^000000. You can find him loitering on one of the Alberta ports.
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
呵呵呵...
不如去和我认识的一个胖乎乎的小水手聊聊，他叫^3355FF戈坦布鲁^000000。你可以在艾尔贝塔港的某个地方找到他。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Tell him that I sent you, and he may tell you more about Turtle Island. He may even know how to get there~
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
告诉他是我派你来的，他可能会告诉你更多关于海龟岛的事。他甚至可能知道怎么去那里~

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Well, then...
Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
那么...
祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Oooh...
Even at this age...
I don't understand
how I can drink so much...
scripts.translation:
[乌龟爷爷]
噢...
都这把年纪了...
我都不明白
自己怎么能喝这么多...

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Heh...
Your eyes...
I can tell you're curious about Turtle Island. I guess you must have been talking to that drunken old man!
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
嘿嘿...
你的眼神...
我看出来你对海龟岛很好奇。我猜你肯定是跟那个醉鬼老头聊过吧！

scripts.text: Do you know about Turtle Island?
scripts.translation: 你知道海龟岛吗？

scripts.text: How can I get there?
scripts.translation: 我怎么去那里？

scripts.text: Stop talking.
scripts.translation: 别说了。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Turtle Island...?
Well, first I think it's fair to warn you that Turtle Island took the lives of my buddies. That's right, I was part of ^3355FFJornadan Niliria^000000's crew.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
海龟岛...？
嗯，首先我觉得有必要提醒你，海龟岛夺走了我伙伴们的生命。没错，我是^3355FF约尔纳丹·尼利里亚^000000船队的一员。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
We wanted to find out if the legends about that island were true, so we left everything behind to learn the truth.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
我们想弄清楚关于那个岛屿的传说是否属实，所以我们抛下一切，去探寻真相。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Jornadan Niliria was one of the greatest treasure hunters ever, and he gathered men for his crew from around the globe. I'm proud to say that each member of our crew was the best in his field.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
约尔纳丹·尼利里亚是有史以来最伟大的寻宝者之一，他从世界各地招募船员。我很自豪地说，我们船队的每一位成员都是各自领域的佼佼者。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
I happened to be the best at navigating. I was only twenty, but I was still invited to his team. It was such an honor to be accepted as an equal amongst these great men.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
我恰好是最擅长导航的。当时我才二十岁，却仍受邀加入他的团队。能与这些杰出人物平起平坐，真是莫大的荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Anyway, our biggest clue about Turtle Island's location hinted that it was near Alberta, so our voyage began from here.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
总之，关于海龟岛位置的最大线索暗示它就在艾尔贝塔附近，所以我们的航行从这里开始。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
We sailed day and night, drifting for weeks, until one day, we were surrounded by an incredibly thick fog. We had no idea of which direction we were going and the mist wouldn't clear.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
我们日夜航行，漂流了数周。直到有一天，我们被极其浓重的浓雾包围。我们完全不知道方向，而雾气迟迟不散。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
But none of us had any regrets and we just kept moving onward. There would be no turning back!
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
但我们谁都没有后悔，只是继续前行。绝不回头！

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Finally, a coral reef sudden appeared and we couldn't steer away from it. Our ship was critically damaged. But when the fog cleared, we saw that we had finally arrived at Turtle Island! It was real!
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
终于，一片珊瑚礁突然出现，我们无法避开。船身受损严重。但当雾气散去时，我们发现终于到达了海龟岛！它是真实存在的！

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
After we made camp on shore and explored the island, we learned something quite remarkable.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
我们在岸上扎营并探索了岛屿，随后发现了一件相当惊人的事情。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
There was a man who had actually made it to Turtle Island before us. His records, however, never reached Rune-Midgarts. He was a great swordmaster known simply as ^3355FFOne^000000.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
有一位男子曾在我们之前到达过海龟岛。然而，他的记录从未传回卢恩·米德加兹。他是一位伟大的剑术大师，人们只称他为^3355FF一^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
According to his records, he had traveled alone to find Turtle Island and made it by himself. But we couldn't find any sign of him anywhere...
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
根据他的记录，他是独自旅行寻找海龟岛并成功抵达的。但我们在任何地方都找不到他的踪迹...

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
As we explored Turtle Island further, we learned that not only was it abundant with treasure, but that it also held an item of great interest.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
随着我们进一步探索海龟岛，我们发现那里不仅宝藏丰富，还有一件令人极其感兴趣的物品。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
From the first explorer's record, some kind of amazing ^3355FFjewel fragment^000000 was mentioned.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
根据第一位探险者的记录，提到了一块惊人的^3355FF宝石碎片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
He had traveled to Turtle Island with the purpose of discovering secrets to the sword arts, and stumbled upon a jewel he claimed was the most beautiful in the world.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
他前往海龟岛的目的是探索剑术的秘密，结果偶然发现了一块他声称是世界上最美丽的宝石。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
By the ^3355FFOne^000000's records, we were able to thoroughly explore all to be seen on Turtle Island. However...
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
根据^3355FF一^000000的记录，我们得以彻底探索海龟岛上所有可见之处。然而...

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Even after months of searching, we could never find a trace of the jewel fragment. Eventually, we had to give up on our search.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
即使搜索了数月，我们也从未找到宝石碎片的踪迹。最终，我们不得不放弃寻找。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Finally, we packed our things to leave the island. But then, as we were traveling at sea, we encountered a thick, blinding fog once again.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
最后，我们收拾行装准备离开岛屿。但就在海上航行时，我们再次遇到了浓重且令人目眩的浓雾。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
We spent a month trying to steer through that mist. When we finally sailed out of that mist, we saw that we had arrived at the other side of Turtle Island!
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
我们花了一个月试图穿过那片迷雾。当我们终于驶出迷雾时，发现我们竟然到达了海龟岛的另一侧！

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Our spirits were crushed!! We tried again and again to leave that place, and spent nearly a year trying to leave but we kept winding up at Turtle Island's shores.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
我们的精神崩溃了！！我们一次又一次试图离开那个地方，花了将近一年时间试图逃离，但总是回到海龟岛的海岸。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
As we struggled with the fog, we lost our comrades one by one. In the end, Jornadan, the drunken old man you met, and myself were the only ones who were able to return home to Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
在与浓雾搏斗的过程中，我们失去了一个又一个同伴。最终，只有你见过的那个醉醺醺的老人约尔纳丹和我，成功回到了艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
We were the only ones who did not give in to despair, and doggedly held onto our hopes. Still, it was by pure luck that we found a way back to Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
我们是唯一没有向绝望屈服、顽强坚守希望的人。即便如此，能回到卢恩·米德加兹也纯属运气。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Well, that's my story. You know, if you want to learn more about Turtle Island, why don't you speak to the scholar on the eastern port of Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
好了，这就是我的故事。你知道吗，如果你想了解更多关于海龟岛的事，不妨去艾尔贝塔东港找那位学者谈谈？

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Heh heh...
I'm sure he can tell give you details that even I wouldn't be able to provide...
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
嘿嘿...
我相信他能给你讲出连我都无法提供的细节...

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
After my story of Turtle Island, you're still not afraid of going? I'm impressed! Alright then...
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
听了我的海龟岛故事，你竟然还一点都不害怕？真让我佩服！好吧...

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
If you wish for me to guide you there, I will charge you 10,000 zeny. I'm the only navigator that can guide you there and back safely.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
如果你想让我带你去那里，我会收取10,000 Zeny。我是唯一能安全地带你往返那里的领航员。

scripts.text: Turtle island -> 10000 zeny
scripts.translation: 前往海龟岛 -> 10000 Zeny

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Alright!!
You've made your choice! With my experience, we will arrive without fail! I appreciate your spirit!
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
好！！
你做出了选择！凭借我的经验，我们一定能顺利抵达！我很欣赏你的勇气！

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Choo Choo*^000000

[Gotanblue]
Hmmm...
Sorry, but you don't have enough zeny. I hope you understand that I can let my expertise and experience be undervalued...
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
嗯...
抱歉，你的Zeny不够。希望你能理解，我不能让我的专业和经验被低估...

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Alright then...
Well, if the spirit of adventure should happen to grab you, I will be here waiting.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
好吧...
如果冒险的冲动再次抓住你，我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Heh...
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Come back whenever you feel you're ready to hear my story, will you?
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
等你准备好听我的故事时，随时回来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Ahhhh...!
Just look at that ocean! It covers the earth as far as the eye can see. Tell me that's not one of the most beautiful things you've ever seen...
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
啊...
看看那片大海！一眼望不到边，覆盖了大地。告诉我，这难道不是你见过的最美丽的景色之一吗...

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Do you want
to return
to Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
你想回
艾尔贝塔吗？

scripts.text: Go to Alberta
scripts.translation: 前往艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Stop talking
scripts.translation: 别说了

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Heh heh...
I certainly hope you've found what you were looking for. Alright, I guess there's always a time for an adventurer to return home...
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布鲁]
嘿嘿...
希望你找到了你想要的东西。好吧，我想冒险者总该有个回家的时间...

scripts.text: ^3355FF* Choo Choo *^000000

[Jornadan Niliria]
Every single place
has its own unique
smells, sights and sounds.
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
每一个地方
都有它独特的
气味、景色和声音。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Even the great, ever expanding sky that's shared by all the peoples of the earth looks strange when you're in a new and foreign land.
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
即使是那片广阔无垠、被地球上所有民族共享的天空，当你身处陌生的异国他乡时，看起来也会变得有些奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Jornandan Niliria]
Heh heh...
Just like my
time on Turtle Island.
Hah Hah Hah~
scripts.translation:
[约尔南丹·尼利里亚]
嘿嘿...
就像我在
海龟岛的那段时光。
哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text: About Turtle island
scripts.translation: 关于海龟岛

scripts.text: You're Jornadan Niliria?!
scripts.translation: 你是约尔纳丹·尼利里亚？！

scripts.text: Stop talking
scripts.translation: 别说了

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Turtle...
Island...
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
海龟...
岛...

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
It's almost silly, but Turtle Island was named simply because it's shaped just like a turtle.
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
说来有点可笑，海龟岛之所以叫这个名字，仅仅是因为它的形状就像一只海龟。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Now, Turtle Island is surrounded by a dense fog. When we were first stuck in it, a lot of us believed it was the result of a curse, or some kind of magic.
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
如今，海龟岛被浓雾环绕。当我们最初被困在那里时，很多人相信这是诅咒或某种魔法的结果。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
But in actuality, the fog is the result of a natural phenomenon. It's created by a waterfall inside a cave located on Turtle Island's coast.
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
但实际上，这种雾是自然现象造成的。它是由海龟岛海岸一处洞穴内的瀑布形成的。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Heh heh...
Once you attain understanding, the truth becomes so simple. I guess confusion and fear is the fog that clouds your judgment, your path on life.
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
嘿嘿...
一旦你理解了，真相就变得如此简单。我想，困惑和恐惧就是遮蔽你判断、你人生道路的迷雾。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Believe it or not, I too used to fear the dangers of Turtle Island. But now that I understand most of its secrets, I look at my experiences at Turtle Island with fondness.
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
信不信由你，我也曾害怕海龟岛的危险。但现在我了解了它的大部分秘密，我反而对在海龟岛的经历充满了怀念。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Still, there is one thing I haven't yet uncovered. The ^3355FFunknown jewel fragment^000000.
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
不过，有一样东西我至今还没有发现。^3355FF未知的宝石碎片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jornandan Niliria]
So, until I find it, I'll keep researching and learn as much as I can until I do. Ha ha ha ha~!
scripts.translation:
[约尔南丹·尼利里亚]
所以，在找到它之前，我会继续研究，尽可能多地了解它。哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Hmm...?
You've heard of me?
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
嗯...？
你听说过我？

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Ah...
I suppose that you know about my treasure hunting days, and probably about Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
啊...
我想你应该知道我的寻宝经历，大概也听说过海龟岛。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Well, as you can see, I'm a little older now. These old bones aren't what they used to be.
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
你看，我现在年纪大了些。这把老骨头可不如从前了。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
But perhaps, someday, if my research bears fruit, I'll venture out once more and seek the one treasure I've never found...
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
不过也许有一天，如果我的研究有所收获，我会再次出发，去寻找那件我从未找到的宝物...

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
When you want to discover the truth, never give in to despair. If you never give up your search, the answer will come to you.
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
当你想要发现真相时，永远不要向绝望屈服。如果你永不放弃寻找，答案终会来到你面前。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
...
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
...

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
...
......
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
...
......

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
By the way, I'm pretty hungry. Why doesn't Alberta have any good restaurants?! I hear they have good dimsum in Kunlun...
scripts.translation:
[约尔纳丹·尼利里亚]
顺便说一句，我有点饿了。为什么艾尔贝塔没有像样的餐厅？！我听说昆仑有很好吃的小笼包...

scripts.text:
[Explorer's Letter]
- O / X / XOVX -
If you find this letter, please don't disregard what you have read.
scripts.translation:
[探险者的信]
- O / X / XOVX -
如果你发现了这封信，请不要忽视你所读到的内容。

scripts.text:
[Explorer's Letter]
Although we have found Turtle Island, it seems our expedition will fail.
scripts.translation:
[探险者的信]
虽然我们找到了海龟岛，但我们的探险似乎要失败了。

scripts.text:
[Explorer's Letter]
Only half of our crew is left, and we only have enough food for ten more days. Our condition is truly grave.
scripts.translation:
[探险者的信]
船员只剩下了一半，而且我们只够吃十天的食物。我们的处境非常严峻。

scripts.text:
[Explorer's Letter]
This damn island must be cursed. There's nothing to eat and we're so close to starving!
scripts.translation:
[探险者的信]
该死的岛肯定是被诅咒了。这里没有任何食物，我们快要饿死了！

scripts.text:
[Explorer's Letter]
If we don't get help or find Alberta soon...
We'll...
scripts.translation:
[探险者的信]
如果我们不能尽快得到援助或找到艾尔贝塔...
我们就会...

scripts.text:
[Voyage log]
03:20 am
There's no light from the stars tonight, and we can't even see a hundred meters ahead of us. The men seem to feel something bad in the air.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
凌晨03:20
今晚看不见星光，前方连一百米都看不清。船员们似乎都感觉到空气中弥漫着不祥的气息。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
The faces of my comrades betrayed their fears. They couldn't manage to sleep last night. I hope we will see sunrise soon...
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
同志们的脸上写满了恐惧。他们昨晚都失眠了。希望我们很快能看到日出...

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
04:10 
5 minutes ago, our comrade, Cooker, was killed when the mast suddenly cracked and fell on his head.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
04:10
五分钟前，我们的同志厨师被突然断裂并砸落的桅杆击中头部，不幸身亡。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
The estimated time of death is 04:07. The mast broke due to the shock of the ship hitting a reef. The left side of the deck also suffered from serious damage.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
预计死亡时间为04:07。桅杆是因为船撞击暗礁的冲击而断裂的。甲板左侧也受到了严重损坏。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
04:45
While two of our workers were fixing the bottom of the deck, they were attacked by monsters that had snuck through cracks in the deck.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
04:45
两名工人正在修补甲板底部时，被从甲板缝隙中钻进来的魔物袭击了。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
These two were lost in the attack. The estimated time of death was 04:32. Fortunately, we are able to stay afloat, but we must hurry and find land.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
这两人在袭击中丧生。预计死亡时间为04:32。幸运的是，船还能漂浮，但我们必须加快速度寻找陆地。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
From the damage to the deck, we've lost 30% of our supplies. At this rate, we'll run out of food soon.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
由于甲板受损，我们损失了30%的补给品。照这个速度下去，我们的食物很快就会耗尽。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
05:23
There seem to be more and more reefs to steer around, and they are growing larger as we travel. I wonder if we'll find land soon...
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
05:23
需要绕行的暗礁似乎越来越多，而且随着航行的推进，它们也越来越大。不知道我们能不能很快找到陆地...

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
Written by
Captain Jornadan Niliria
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
记录者
船长 约尔纳丹·尼利里亚

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe paper is torn and seaweed and mold are stuck to the paper. It seems this log is in very poor condition...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF纸张已经破损，上面粘着海草和霉菌。看来这份日志的状况非常糟糕...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThere is a banana leaf between some of the pages. Here is what is written.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在几页纸之间夹着一片香蕉叶。上面写着以下内容。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
O / X date
Just after we arrived on Turtle Island, we frantically searched all over for food.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
O / X 日
刚到达海龟岛后，我们疯狂地到处寻找食物。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
It was so bad, that you could see the bones through our skin.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
情况非常糟糕，我们瘦得皮包骨头。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
X / X date
We found some kind of fruit to eat! It's covered in some sort of yellow skin and looks like a banana!
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
X / X 日
我们找到了一种可以吃的果实！它外面包着黄色的皮，看起来像香蕉！

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
XO / X date
Well, it wasn't exactly like the bananas we have in Rune-Midgarts, but it was very similar.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
XO / X 日
嗯，它和卢恩·米德加兹的香蕉不太一样，但非常相似。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
O / O date
In the middle of the night, one of the men reported that he felt sick after eating the food.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
O / O 日
半夜里，一名船员报告说，吃了那些食物后感到恶心。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
OO / O date
Another crew member, Berot Berot, was also found to have severe indigestion.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
OO / O 日
另一名船员贝罗特·贝罗特也被发现患有严重的消化不良。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
It's now becoming very clear that the food we have been eating contains some kind of poison.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
现在越来越明显了，我们一直在吃的食物里含有某种毒素。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
XO / O date
The third person to experience indigestion passed away today. We are all very worried.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
XO / O 日
第三名出现消化不良症状的人今天去世了。我们都非常担心。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
Our suspicions were confirmed when we found that the animals on Turtle Island wouldn't eat the bananas we found.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
当我们发现海龟岛上的动物不吃我们找到的香蕉时，我们的怀疑得到了证实。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
OX / O date
We decided to seal away this poisonous fruit, but learned that it didn't rot, not even after we removed the skin.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
OX / O 日
我们决定封存这种有毒的水果，但发现它不会腐烂，即使剥去果皮也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
We have no idea why it's harmful to eat, or why it never perishes, but it be of some medical or scientific interest.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
我们不知道它为什么有害，也不知道它为什么不会腐烂，但它可能对医学或科学研究有价值。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
In the meantime, we've decided to bury this fruit until we can get back to Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
在此期间，我们决定将这种水果埋起来，直到我们回到艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text: ^3355FFIn the Voyage log is a thin key marked with a skull. You've taken this Skull key, as it may be of some use later.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF航海日志中有一把刻有骷髅图案的细钥匙。你拿走了这把骷髅钥匙，因为它以后可能会有用。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou notice a page with a stamp shaped like a bird's foot. The black ink smells sort of like fruit.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你注意到一页纸上有一个鸟爪形状的印章。黑色的墨水闻起来有点像水果的味道。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
X / OO date
We've found evidence that other people were here, and that we are not the first to find Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
X / OO 日
我们发现了其他人曾在此地的证据，我们并不是第一个发现海龟岛的人。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
There was at least one person who made it here before us. Hopefully, his records are on the island somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
至少有一人先于我们到达这里。希望他的记录在岛上的某个地方。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
Starting tomorrow, we will begin searching for these hidden records.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
从明天开始，我们将开始寻找这些隐藏的记录。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
O / OO date
We are having difficulty trying to find any records. Is it possible that the first people here wrote nothing of their journey?
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
O / OO 日
我们很难找到任何记录。难道第一批来到这里的人没有写下他们的旅程吗？

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
XO / OO date
We finally found the records we have been searching for.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
XO / OO 日
我们终于找到了我们一直在寻找的记录。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
His notes were so hard to find because only one man, rather than a whole team, came to Turtle Island before us!
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
他的笔记之所以很难找到，是因为先于我们来到海龟岛的只有一个人，而不是整个团队！

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
This man was a swordsman simply known as 'One.' His records tell much about what can be found on Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
这名男子是一名剑士，人们只称他为“一”。他的记录详细描述了海龟岛上能找到的东西。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
His records were written on animals skin, but they were durable and still easy to read after all this time.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
他的记录写在动物皮上，但非常耐用，经过这么长时间后仍然清晰易读。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
According to his notes, Turtle Island consists of 4 levels. Although there are no people here, but there are many traps and devices which operate through a mysterious force.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
根据他的笔记，海龟岛由4层组成。虽然这里没有人，但有许多通过神秘力量运作的陷阱和装置。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
Still, it is certain that something has some control over Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
不过，可以确定的是，某物在控制着海龟岛。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
To keep this record safe, our crew has decided to hide this valuable record on the second level of Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[航海日志]
为了安全保存这份记录，我们的船员决定将这份珍贵的记录藏在海龟岛的第二层。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
Search here...

[航海日志]

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
Where did all my men go?!
This is horrible~!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
我的手下都去哪了？！
太糟糕了~！

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
Oh...
*Whew!*
Finally, another person.
Tell me who you are!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
哦...
*呼！*
终于又来了一个人。
告诉我你是谁！

scripts.text: Who are you to ask?
scripts.translation: 你凭什么问我？

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: First, tell me who you are.
scripts.translation: 先告诉我你是谁。

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
How dare you speak to me in that tone! Don't you know who I am?! I'm Takuyaka, leader of the Security Knights of Alberta! Kobolds and Porings quiver in fear when they hear my name...
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
你竟敢用这种语气跟我说话！你难道不知道我是谁吗？！我是拓也香，艾尔贝塔安全骑士团的首领！刺锤犬妖和波利听到我的名字都会吓得发抖...

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
So tell me the truth! You came here for treasure, didn't you?! You want it all for yourself! You bastard! Now get off this island! Go, shoo!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
所以老实交代！你是来寻宝的，对吧？！你想独吞所有宝物！你这个混蛋！现在立刻离开这座岛！走，快走！

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
{0}?
Well, your name sounds better than mine. And you have more hair on your head as well. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
{0}？
嗯，你的名字听起来比我的好听。而且你头上的头发也比我多。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
Do you have anything to give me? You know, some food or zeny? It's not like I really need it, it's just... Oh bother. Never mind. Perhaps we'll meet later.
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
你有什么东西可以给我吗？比如食物或者Zeny？其实我也不是真的需要，只是...哎呀，算了。也许我们以后还会见面。

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
I've heard that many treasures can be found on Turtle Island. If I can take enough home, I'll be rich! Well, we're supposed to rescue lost adventurers too, but whatever. As leader, I can do whatever I want!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
我听说海龟岛上有很多宝物。如果我带够多的回去，我就能发财了！虽然我们也应该去救援迷路的冒险者，但无所谓。作为首领，我想做什么就做什么！

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
However, we're totally lost. Meaning we can't find any treasure or even rescue any people. Grrr...! Where are my useless soldiers! I've probably spoiled them with too much food!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
不过，我们完全迷路了。也就是说，我们找不到任何宝物，甚至无法救援任何人。可恶...！我那群没用的士兵都在哪！我大概是给他们吃了太多好吃的，把他们惯坏了！

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
If you see any of them, tell them they must assemble here! Alright?!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
如果你看到他们，告诉他们必须在这里集合！听到了吗？！

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
Me? I'm Takuyaka. A tall, dark, handsome, and dashing leader, as well as a fearsome knight! I have come to save the foolish people of Alberta that have come seeking treasure on Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
我？我是拓也香。一个高大、英俊、潇洒的首领，也是一位令人畏惧的骑士！我来这里是为了拯救那些来到海龟岛寻宝的艾尔贝塔愚民。

scripts.text:
[Mudasamu]
Really, now?
scripts.translation:
[穆达萨姆]
真的假的？

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
Quiet!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
安静！

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
Anyway, we came here with the purest of intents. But right when we arrived, we were attacked by monsters! Because of the confusion from all the fighting, my soldiers were scattered.
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
总之，我们是怀着最纯真的意图来到这里的。但刚一到，就被魔物袭击了！因为战斗造成的混乱，我的士兵们四散奔逃。

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
Mudasamu!
Why is this
happening to me!!!!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
穆达萨姆！
为什么这种事
会发生在
我身上！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mudasamu]
Huh...!
Why should you
be surprised,
you chubby dwarf?
scripts.translation:
[穆达萨姆]
哈...！
你惊讶什么，
你这胖矮人？

scripts.text:
[Scared Voice]
Wh-wh-whaat?!
scripts.translation:
[害怕的声音]
什...什...什么？！

scripts.text:
[Terrified Voice]
What's that noise?!
M-M-Mudasamu!
Protect me!
scripts.translation:
[惊恐的声音]
那是什么声音？！
穆...穆达萨姆！
保护我！

scripts.text:
[Mudasamu]
No.
And shut up.
scripts.translation:
[穆达萨姆]
不。
闭嘴。

scripts.text:
[Mudasamu]
My name is Mudasamu...
Second in command of the
Alberta Security Knights.
scripts.translation:
[穆达萨姆]
我是穆达萨姆...
艾尔贝塔保安骑士团的
副指挥官。

scripts.text:
[Mudasamu]
We've come here to rescue treasure hunters that might be in trouble. However, our leader is this porky specimen right next to me. So I guess I foresaw that this mission would fail.
scripts.translation:
[穆达萨姆]
我们来到这里是为了救援可能有麻烦的寻宝者。然而，我们的首领就是旁边这个肥硕的家伙。所以我早就料到这次任务会失败了。

scripts.text:
[Mudasamu]
Basically, our leader was so distracted by the idea of finding treasure himself that we've lost our men. It's bad enough that he's a fat slob, but he's a greedy slob too!
scripts.translation:
[穆达萨姆]
基本上，我们的首领因为想着自己寻宝而分心，导致我们失去了士兵。他不仅是个胖子，还是个贪婪的家伙！

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
Hey, Mudasamu!
Are you talking
about me?!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
嘿，穆达萨姆！
你在说
我吗？！

scripts.text:
[Mudasamu]
No, fat one,
we're not
talking about you.
scripts.translation:
[穆达萨姆]
不，胖子，
我们说的
不是你。

scripts.text:
[Mudasamu]
*Sigh...*
I better be paid
overtime for
putting up with this.
scripts.translation:
[穆达萨姆]
*叹气...*
忍受这些，
我最好能拿到
加班费。

scripts.text:
[?]
Where are they?
Oh hey! You're an adventurer, aren't you? Do you know where my comrades are?
scripts.translation:
[?]
他们在哪？
哦，嘿！你是冒险者，对吧？你知道我的同志们在哪吗？

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text: Sorry, I don't.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不知道。

scripts.text: Why did you come here?
scripts.translation: 你为什么来这里？

scripts.text: How did you get here?
scripts.translation: 你是怎么来到这里的？

scripts.text:
[Passats]
My name is Passats, a proud Security Knight of Alberta. We've obtained some information that some people came here to seek treasure.
scripts.translation:
[帕萨茨]
我是帕萨茨，艾尔贝塔引以为傲的保安骑士。我们得到了一些情报，说有人来这里寻宝。

scripts.text:
[Passats]
Our task here is to save people, but when we arrived on Turtle Island, we were attacked by a mob of monsters! So we all got scattered.
scripts.translation:
[帕萨茨]
我们在这里的任务是救人，但当我们到达海龟岛时，被一群魔物袭击了！所以我们四散奔逃。

scripts.text:
[Passats]
Now I'm all alone. If you find anyone else in my unit, would you let them know?
scripts.translation:
[帕萨茨]
现在只有我一个人了。如果你找到我小队的其他人，能让他们知道我的位置吗？

scripts.text:
[Passats]
Ah well...
Well, if you happen to find anyone else in my unit, would you let them know where I am?
scripts.translation:
[帕萨茨]
唉...
如果你碰巧找到我小队的其他人，能让他们知道我在哪吗？

scripts.text:
[Passat]
Oh, and if you find our leader, kick his butt, will you? It's so fat, there's no way you can miss.
scripts.translation:
[帕萨特]
哦，对了，如果你找到我们的首领，帮我揍他一顿，好吗？他那么胖，你肯定找得到的。

scripts.text:
[Passats]
Oh...
And, um...
Cheer up!
scripts.translation:
[帕萨茨]
哦...
那个，嗯...
振作起来！

scripts.text:
[Passats]
There are a lot of stories about the amazing wealth that can be found on this island. However, everyone assumed that it was impossible to find Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[帕萨茨]
关于这座岛上藏有惊人财富的故事有很多。然而，大家都认为找到海龟岛是不可能的。

scripts.text:
[Passats]
But then, the problem began when some navigator actually knew the way to Turtle Island. I think he'll take just about anybody for 10,000 zeny!
scripts.translation:
[帕萨茨]
但后来，问题出现了，因为有一位领航员竟然知道去海龟岛的路。我想他大概只要10,000 Zeny就会带任何人去吧！

scripts.text:
[Passats]
So anyway, some of the people of Alberta have been foolishly coming here, hoping to find treasure. But of course, they can't fight monsters.
scripts.translation:
[帕萨茨]
总之，艾尔贝塔的一些人愚蠢地来到这里，希望能找到宝藏。但当然，他们打不过魔物。

scripts.text:
[Passats]
So now we're here in order to seek out towners in trouble, and send them safely back home. Of course, now it seems that we also need rescuing...
scripts.translation:
[帕萨茨]
所以我们现在在这里，是为了寻找陷入困境的镇民，并安全地送他们回家。当然，现在看来，我们也需要被救援了...

scripts.text:
[Passats]
Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[帕萨茨]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Passats]
No clue.
scripts.translation:
[帕萨茨]
完全不知道。

scripts.text: How can that be?!
scripts.translation: 怎么会这样？！

scripts.text:
[Passats]
Oh, don't be angry. I just drank too much vodka! Before we arrived I was still unconscious and when I finally sobered up, I was here. I'm so embarrassed~
scripts.translation:
[帕萨茨]
哦，别生气。我只是喝了太多伏特加！在我们到达之前我还处于昏迷状态，等我终于清醒过来时，我就在这里了。我真丢人~

scripts.text:
[Passats]
I...
I'm a victim too~
scripts.translation:
[帕萨茨]
我...
我也是受害者~

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
Oh? Are you a civilian? Nice to meet you. I'm a mighty Security Knight of Alberta, Jayprocat.
scripts.translation:
[杰普罗卡特]
哦？你是平民吗？很高兴见到你。我是艾尔贝塔强大的保安骑士，杰普罗卡特。

scripts.text: What is that, exactly?
scripts.translation: 那到底是什么？

scripts.text: I'm not impressed.
scripts.translation: 我不太感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
Well...
We're supposed to protect the people of Alberta. That's our job as proud Security Knights.
scripts.translation:
[杰普罗卡特]
嗯...
我们本应该保护艾尔贝塔的人民。这是我们作为自豪的保安骑士的职责。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
So when a bunch of them caught treasure fever and started coming here, we came to rescue them. Anyway, that was the plan.
scripts.translation:
[杰普罗卡特]
所以当一群人染上寻宝热并开始来这里时，我们来救援他们了。总之，计划是这样的。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
It turns out that by some joke by fate, our leader is this pudgy guy who attracted a mob on monsters to us by noisily digging up treasure, instead of doing what we were supposed to do.
scripts.translation:
[杰普罗卡特]
结果由于命运的捉弄，我们的首领是个胖乎乎的家伙，他没有做我们应该做的事，而是大声地挖掘宝藏，结果引来了一群魔物攻击我们。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
*Sigh...*
Why wasn't Mudasamu in charge? With him as leader, I would've been home for dinner...
scripts.translation:
[杰普罗卡特]
*叹气...*
为什么不是穆达萨姆负责？如果他是首领，我早就回家吃晚饭了...

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
Well...
It's true that we pretty much messed up our current mission to save anyone here seeking for treasure, since we need rescuing now as well.
scripts.translation:
[杰普罗卡特]
嗯...
确实，我们基本上搞砸了当前拯救这里寻宝者的任务，因为现在我们也需要被救援了。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
*Sniff*
Why did we have to be attacked by so many monsters on my first mission? I'm... I'm just a new recruit...
scripts.translation:
[杰普罗卡特]
*吸鼻子*
为什么在我的第一次任务中就要被这么多魔物攻击？我...我只是一个新兵...

scripts.text: Why did you run away?
scripts.translation: 你为什么逃跑？

scripts.text: I don't care.
scripts.translation: 我不感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
No, I didn't just run away! The monsters were too stong and there were so many of them! Plus, it's our damn leader's fault.
scripts.translation:
[杰普罗卡特]
不，我不是单纯地逃跑！那些魔物太强了，而且数量太多了！再说了，这都是我们那个该死的首领的错。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
The monsters are all highly evolved turtles. And this island even looks like a turtle! But I guess you knew that already.
scripts.translation:
[杰普罗卡特]
那些魔物全是进化后的高阶乌龟。而且这座岛看起来也像只乌龟！不过我想你早就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
I had no idea that this island's monsters were so much stronger than the ones that live near Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[杰普罗卡特]
我完全没想到这座岛上的魔物比艾尔贝塔附近的要强这么多。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
Their shells are so tough, and we can't seem to find any sort of weak point! I have no idea how to fight these turtles!
scripts.translation:
[杰普罗卡特]
它们的壳太硬了，我们似乎找不到任何弱点！我根本不知道该怎么对付这些乌龟！

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
You're so mean...
I mean, I'm really new at this!
scripts.translation:
[杰普罗卡特]
你太坏了...
我是说，我真的是新手啊！

scripts.text:
[Squall]
Am I the only one left? Where are all my comrades?! I... I'm about to go crazy!
scripts.translation:
[斯考尔]
难道只剩下我一个人了吗？我的同志们都在哪里？！我...我快要疯了！

scripts.text: Maybe they ran away?
scripts.translation: 也许他们逃跑了？

scripts.text: What happened?
scripts.translation: 发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Squall]
No, we would never run away from the face of danger.
scripts.translation:
[斯考尔]
不，我们绝不会在危险面前逃跑。

scripts.text:
[Squall]
Well, we sort of did, but that was because it was a direct order from our leader! If a knight is loyal and proud, he will accept his leader's orders without question!
scripts.translation:
[斯考尔]
好吧，我们确实跑了，但那是因为那是首领的直接命令！如果一名骑士忠诚且自豪，他会毫不犹豫地接受首领的命令！

scripts.text:
[Squall]
Even if that leader is a little greedy, with hair that might be thinning...
scripts.translation:
[斯考尔]
即使那个首领有点贪婪，头发可能有点稀疏...

scripts.text:
[Squall]
^FF0000And has the body
of a pregnant whale^000000.
scripts.translation:
[斯考尔]
^FF0000而且身材像怀孕的鲸鱼一样^000000。

scripts.text:
[Squall]
Oh wait!
I shouldn't
have said that!
What I meant
to say was...
scripts.translation:
[斯考尔]
哎呀！
我不该说那个的！
我想说的是...

scripts.text:
[Squall]
^CC0000And has the
body of a whale
pregnant with twins^000000.
scripts.translation:
[斯考尔]
^CC0000而且身材像怀了双胞胎的鲸鱼^000000。

scripts.text:
[Squall]
Grrrr...!
I'm so angry!
Why can't Mudasamu
be our leader?!
scripts.translation:
[斯考尔]
呜...
我气死了！
为什么穆达萨姆不能当我们的首领？！

scripts.text:
[Squall]
We had good plans for this mission, made by our second in command, Mudasamu. However, they were executely poorly by the first in command.
scripts.translation:
[斯考尔]
我们为这次任务制定了周密的计划，是由副指挥官穆达萨姆制定的。然而，指挥官却执行得一塌糊涂。

scripts.text:
[Squall]
Whenever Takuyaka leads a mission, he always manages to mess it up! Why do the leaders in Alberta like him anyway?!
scripts.translation:
[斯考尔]
每次拓也香领导任务，总是搞得一团糟！艾尔贝塔的高层为什么那么喜欢他？！

scripts.text:
[Squall]
*Sniff*
I sweat and I bleed for the Alberta Security Knights, and still I'm tortured by the fact that Sir Porky commands us. I hate it!
scripts.translation:
[斯考尔]
*吸鼻子*
我为艾尔贝塔安全骑士流汗流血，却还要忍受猪头爵士指挥我们。我讨厌这样！

scripts.text:
[Squall]
Our weapon and armor budget is always gone after Takuyaka visits a buffet... Why do we have to be so miserable?!
scripts.translation:
[斯考尔]
我们的武器和防具预算总是在拓也香去自助餐厅后花光...为什么我们要这么悲惨？！

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
Hm? I'm surprised that someone around here is still alive.
scripts.translation:
[尼苏蕾亚]
嗯？我很惊讶这里居然还有人活着。

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
I'm beginning to think all my comrades have been killed by the monsters here...
scripts.translation:
[尼苏蕾亚]
我开始觉得，我的同志们可能都已经被这里的魔物杀害了...

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
Having a
tough time?
scripts.translation:
[尼苏蕾亚]
遇到麻烦了？

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
Even though you're pretty strong, sooner or later you might need a reprieve. I can send you back to Alberta right now if you want.
scripts.translation:
[尼苏蕾亚]
虽然你很强大，但迟早也会需要休息一下。如果你愿意，我现在就可以把你送回艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text: Yes, Help me.
scripts.translation: 是的，帮帮我。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
Okay then, let me activate this teleport thingee donated to us by Kafra Corporation...
scripts.translation:
[尼苏蕾亚]
好的，让我启动这个由卡普拉总公司捐赠给我们的传送装置...

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
Ah, that's the spirit! You should be careful though. And if you see any other of my comrades, let them know I'm here, would you?
scripts.translation:
[尼苏蕾亚]
啊，这才是好样的！不过你要小心。如果你遇到我的其他同志，请告诉他们我还在这里，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
Well, good luck!
scripts.translation:
[尼苏蕾亚]
那么，祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
You look lost! If you stick around here, well, the monsters will probably get the best of you sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[尼苏蕾亚]
你看起来迷路了！如果你留在这里，迟早会被魔物打败的。

scripts.text:
[Nyusurea]
Anyway...
Good luck!
You'll need it!
scripts.translation:
[尼乌苏蕾亚]
总之...
祝你好运！
你会用得上的！

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
Huh...
You look calm and collected. If all our soldiers were as strong as you, we probably would not have been scattered.
scripts.translation:
[尼苏蕾亚]
嗯...
你看起来很冷静沉着。如果我们的士兵都像你一样强大，我们大概就不会落得如此分散的境地了。

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
I have dreams of becoming a great knight, but since our 'leader' is all plump and no brains, we're stuck in this predicament.
scripts.translation:
[尼苏蕾亚]
我梦想着成为一名伟大的骑士，但既然我们的“首领”是个只有肥肉没有脑子的家伙，我们就只能被困在这种困境中了。

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
Anyway, be careful in this third level of Turtle Island. A lot of our men were annihilated when they went to explore the East and North sides, so be careful!
scripts.translation:
[尼苏蕾亚]
总之，在海龟岛第三层要小心。我们有很多人在探索东侧和北侧时被歼灭了，所以务必小心！

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
But... this world is...
What a big world... Not just humans...
Other lifeforms just like us...
Where could they be?...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
但是...这个世界是...
多么广阔的世界...不仅仅是人类...
还有像我们一样的其他生命形式...
它们会在哪里呢？...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...Their lives.. and...
Their kingdom... and land...
Where could they be...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...它们的生活...以及...
它们的王国...和土地...
它们会在哪里...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
If they exist, that'd be great...
No... they must exist...
I wish one day... one day I can go there...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
如果它们存在的话，那该多好啊...
不...它们一定存在...
我希望有一天...有一天我能去那里...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
If it's too painful...
It's better if I don't...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
如果太痛苦的话...
最好还是不要...

scripts.text: -Silent pause-
scripts.translation: -沉默的停顿-

scripts.text:
-{0} starts to speak-
-And tells him of the journeys-
-Adventures, joy, sorrow, and loss-
-One by one to the boy-
scripts.translation:
-{0}开始说话-
-向他讲述旅途-
-冒险、喜悦、悲伤和失去-
-一件一件地告诉男孩-

scripts.text:
-Fighting monsters, and winning-
-Coming across many people, and-
-leaving them, and tells of many other things-
-As much as possible, to the boy.-
scripts.translation:
-与魔物战斗并获胜-
-遇到许多人，然后-
-离开他们，并讲述许多其他事情-
-尽可能多地告诉男孩。-

scripts.text:
-Much has happened, and-
-There were many dangers, but in the end-
-Happy things outweighs the bad,-
-What I have received is more than what I have lost.-
-I try hard to convey this message to Iromo.-
scripts.translation:
-发生了很多事情，-
-经历了许多危险，但最终-
-快乐的事情多于悲伤，-
-我得到的比我失去的更多。-
-我努力向伊罗莫传达这个信息。-

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...

[Iromo]
...So in the end...
You just want me... to go outside...
Am I right...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...所以到头来...
你只是想让我...出去...
对吧...

scripts.text: It's true, you'll get more than you pay.
scripts.translation: 没错，你会得到比付出更多的。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...

[Iromo]
...But now... I am not going outside.
I am still afraid...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...但现在...我不出去。
我还是害怕...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Even if I don't go out right now,
I will still... make an effort to do so.
One day, I will surely become...
..An adventurer... and do many, many things.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
即使我现在不出去，
我也会...努力尝试的。
总有一天，我一定会成为...
...一名冒险者...去做很多很多事情。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
The world is big, there are many things...
I have not seen yet. Yes... I want to...
...see them all.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
世界很大，有很多事情...
我还没有见过。是的...我想...
...去看看它们。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
To go on an adventure with my friends,
I would still rather stay here.
I would still rather stay here quietly and safely.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
虽然想和朋友们去冒险，
但我还是宁愿留在这里。
我还是宁愿安静、安全地留在这里。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Alright...go away. I know...
I know what you want to say...what an annoyance...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
好了...走吧。我知道...
我知道你想说什么...真烦人...

scripts.text:
-You don't give up, and continue to-
-tell of the stories-
-shared with friends.-
-You tell of the truth.-
scripts.translation:
-你不放弃，继续-
-讲述那些-
-与朋友分享的故事。-
-你讲述的是真相。-

scripts.text:
-Someone met long ago,-
-Suddenly leaves,-
-and finally reunited, but-
-because of the cruel fate-
-he dies in this tragedy.-
-In the end, it's all a tragedy...-
scripts.translation:
-很久以前认识的人，-
-突然离开，-
-最终重逢，但-
-因为残酷的命运-
-他死在了这场悲剧中。-
-到头来，这都是一场悲剧...-

scripts.text:
-But you emphasize -
-Even though the ending is tragic,-
-A beautiful friendship-
-Will not disappear because of that.-
scripts.translation:
-但你强调-
-虽然结局是悲剧，-
-但美好的友谊-
-不会因为这就消失。-

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...

[Iromo]
...Thank you for telling me...
They are great friends...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...谢谢你告诉我...
他们是好朋友...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...And? ...What do you...
Want to say to me this time...
You've told me many stories...
...How about one of your own?
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...然后呢？...你这次...
想对我说什么...
你已经给我讲了很多故事...
...不如讲讲你自己的？

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...And? ...What do you...
Want to say to me this time...
You've told me many stories...
...How about one of your own?
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...然后呢？...你这次...
想对我说什么...
你已经给我讲了很多故事...
...不如讲讲你自己的？

scripts.text: Friendship cannot be forgotten.
scripts.translation: 友谊不能被遗忘。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...
To have that kind of friends and that kind of friendship...
scripts.translation: 拥有那样的朋友和那样的友谊...

scripts.text: You need to get out of your house and see the world.
scripts.translation: 你需要走出家门，去看看这个世界。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Though you changed a story... but...
You're still talking about this...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
虽然你换了个故事...但是...
你还是在说这个...

scripts.text: To be honest, the other kids miss you.
scripts.translation: 说实话，其他孩子都很想念你。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...Him? ...Miss me? That's...
Something from a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...他？...想念我？那是...
很久以前的事了...

scripts.text: There are many things you don't know yet.
scripts.translation: 还有很多事情你并不知道。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...
Don't you think it's a waste to stay home?
scripts.translation: 你觉得一直待在家里不是太浪费了吗？

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...
In order to find safety, you would give up fun adventures?
scripts.translation: 为了寻求安全，你愿意放弃有趣的冒险吗？

scripts.text: That's too bad. Change is a very fun thing.
scripts.translation: 真遗憾。变化是一件非常有趣的事。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...Change...
Is fun...?
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...变化...
很有趣...？

scripts.text: Outside this city and this kingdom, there is a bigger world.
scripts.translation: 在这座城市和这个王国之外，还有一个更大的世界。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...
Since it's so big, there are many fun things.
scripts.translation: 正因为很大，所以有很多有趣的事情。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Really...? Other than Alberta, and Rune-Midgarts...?
There are other places...?
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
真的...？除了艾尔贝塔和卢恩·米德加兹...？
还有其他地方...？

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
But... there will also be many troubles...
Isn't that true... I can't relax...
I... don't like those...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
但是...也会有很多麻烦...
是这样吗...我无法放松...
我...不喜欢那些...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
To go on an adventure with my friends,
I would still rather stay here.
I would still rather stay here quietly and safely.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
虽然想和朋友们去冒险，
但我还是宁愿留在这里。
我还是宁愿安静、安全地留在这里。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Alright... go away. I know...
I know what you want to say... what an annoyance...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
好了...走吧。我知道...
我知道你想说什么...真烦人...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...You really are annoying...
What exactly do you want from me...?
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...你真的很烦...
你到底想从我这里得到什么...？

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
A long time ago... I had a friend just like you.
I met him when I went out to play...
But...
He must've forgotten all about me...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
很久以前...我有个和你一样的朋友。
我出去玩的时候遇见了他...
但是...
他一定已经把我忘得一干二净了...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Nevermind... it's not unexpected...
To go on an adventure with my friends,
I would still rather stay here.
I would still rather stay here quietly and safely.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
算了...这也不奇怪...
和朋友们去冒险，
我还是更愿意留在这里。
我还是更愿意在这里安静、安全地待着。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...What... Right now, I...
I don't want to... hear anything...
Go away...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...什么...现在，我...
我不想...听任何话...
走吧...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...What is it... this time...?
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...这次又是什么...？

scripts.text: A story about a pair of siblings.
scripts.translation: 关于一对兄妹的故事。

scripts.text:
-Tell him about Kazien and Lyozien.-
-Because of ill fate,-
-They were born to do illegal tasks-
-But the innocent Lyozien-
-Trusted his brother...-
scripts.translation:
-告诉他卡济恩和廖齐恩的故事。-
-因为命运多舛，-
-他们生来就要从事非法的任务，-
-但天真的廖齐恩-
-却信任着他的哥哥...-

scripts.text:
-And even though Kazien has become-
-a criminal, but as an older brother-
-He hopes to take good care of his younger brother.-
scripts.translation:
-尽管卡济恩已经-
-成为了罪犯，但作为哥哥，-
-他希望好好照顾自己的弟弟。-

scripts.text:
-This is a story from far away,-
-But because you have seen it with your own eyes,-
-You can clearly express-
-Your feelings.-
scripts.translation:
-这是一个来自远方的故事，-
-但因为你亲眼所见，-
-你可以清晰地表达-
-你的感受。-

scripts.text:
-This story must be able to-
-Stir up the interest of-
-Iromo, who has always wanted a brother.-
scripts.translation:
-这个故事一定能-
-激起-
-一直渴望有个哥哥的伊罗莫-
-的兴趣。-

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
I see...They were great siblings...
Tragic...but also beautiful.
If only...I can be the protagonist...
..in such a story...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
原来如此...他们是伟大的兄妹...
很悲惨...但也很美好。
要是...我能成为...
...这样故事的主角就好了...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...But...I'm an only child...
...So there's nothing I can do...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...但是...我是独生子...
...所以我什么都做不了...

scripts.text: You don't need to be related by blood to be brothers.
scripts.translation: 不需要血缘关系也能成为兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...
You can find make of these brothers outside.
scripts.translation: 在外面可以找到这样的兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...Outside?...
But if you stay at home, nothing will change.
scripts.translation: 但如果你一直待在家里，什么都不会改变。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...

[Iromo]
...What... So it's all my fault...
What you want to say...
...is always the same...
Get out... I'm not in the mood...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...什么...所以都是我的错...
你想说的...
...总是那一套...
出去...我没心情...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...I'm not in a good mood, get out...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...我现在心情不好，出去...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
You never give up, don't you?
What are you trying to say?
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
你还真是不死心啊。
你到底想说什么？

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
It is frustrating. But...
Why do you care about me so much?
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
真让人头疼。但是...
你为什么这么关心我？

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Really, its not that bad...
I wish I could have a sister like you.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
真的，没那么严重...
我真希望能有个像你这样的妹妹。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Really, its not that bad...
I wish I could have a brother like you.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
真的，没那么严重...
我真希望能有个像你这样的哥哥。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Do you have any stories about siblings?
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
你有什么关于兄弟姐妹的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
What? Anything to say?
Seriously!
Just leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
什么？有话就说？
认真的吗！
别管我了。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Thank you for caring...
But that is ok...No thanks...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
谢谢你的关心...
但没关系...不用谢...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Oh, you made the furious cat
go away from the village?
...Oh, you did..Thanks!
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
哦，你把那只发怒的猫
赶出村庄了？
...哦，你做了...谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
But, I am still scared of
being outside.
I would rather stay at home.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
但是，我还是害怕
去外面。
我宁愿待在家里。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Thank you for being helpful.
But, no thanks.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
谢谢你的帮忙。
但是，不用谢。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
If I go out, I will see the scary cat.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
如果我出去，就会看到那只可怕的猫。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
He will bite me..and
scratch me again.
I should stay at home.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
它会咬我...
还会抓伤我。
我应该待在家里。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...Huh? This smell...
This is the one I like the most.
Ha Ha!
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...咦？这个味道...
这是我最喜欢的味道。
哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
But..my mom is beside me.
(Wink, Wink)
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
但是...妈妈就在我身边。
(眨眼，眨眼)

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...Thanks! I need to hide this.
Anyway, thank you!
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...谢谢！我得把这个藏起来。
总之，谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
It smells so good.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
闻起来好香。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Huh?? If I go out,
then can I get these things?
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
咦？？如果我出去，
就能得到这些东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
But... I'm scared...
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
但是...我很害怕...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
I am scared. If I go out...
No, I don't want to get hurt again.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
我很害怕。如果我出去...
不，我不想再受伤了。

scripts.text: Again?
scripts.translation: 再次

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...there is a weird cat that can walk on two feet.
I like cats so I approached him.
Then suddenly he scratched and bit me.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...有一只奇怪的猫，会用两条腿走路。
我很喜欢猫，所以靠近了它。
然后它突然抓伤了我，还咬了我。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
I don't want to see the cat again.
If I go out, I will see him. It is scary.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
我不想再看到那只猫了。
如果我出去，就会看到它。好可怕。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
... I don't like being outside of the village.
Being inside of the house is the best.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
...我不喜欢待在村庄外面。
待在家里是最好的。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Mother told me that
I should go out and play
with friends. But I don't
want to go out with them.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
妈妈告诉我，
我应该出去和朋友玩。
但是我不想和他们出去。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
It is little bit inconvenient that
I can't get delicious food
that grows outside of the village.
I can stand it.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
有点不方便的是，
我拿不到村庄外面长的美味食物。
但我能忍受。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
But, I can have other food
instead of the outside food.
That way I don't have to go out.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
但是，我可以吃其他食物，
代替外面的食物。
这样我就不需要出去了。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
I like my house and my room.
I don't want to go out.
scripts.translation:
[伊罗莫]
我喜欢我的房子和我的房间。
我不想出去。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Thank you for helping my son.
But I think we can't do anything
about him anymore.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
谢谢你帮助我的儿子。
但我觉得我们对他无能为力了。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Iromo was really active and
curious about the world.
He wanted to see all the
sights of the world.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
伊罗莫以前很活泼，
对世界充满好奇。
他想看遍世界的美景。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
But look at him now.
He doesn't go out anymore.
He is just stuck inside of his room.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
但看看他现在。
他再也不出去了。
他只是被困在他的房间里。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
He became a timid person.
If he has an argument with me,
he doesn't talk to me for a week.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
他变得很胆小。
如果和我吵架，
他会一周不跟我说话。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
You might have
a hard time getting
Iromo to talk to you.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
你可能很难
让伊罗莫跟你说话。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Oh, I remember
what happened last time...
One day, Iromo came home
with tears in his eyes
And he seemed hurt.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
啊，我想起来了...
上次发生的事。
有一天，伊罗莫哭着回了家，
看起来受了伤。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
It was not a big injury.
I was worried about him so much.
But, he never tells me what happened that day.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
伤得不重。
我当时非常担心他。
但他从来不告诉我那天发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
After that day, he hasn't talked to people much and doesn't go out at all.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
从那天起，他就很少跟人说话了，也完全不出门。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
I hope he tells me what happened that day.
Iromo was such a good boy...
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
我希望他能告诉我那天发生了什么。
伊罗莫以前是个多么好的孩子啊...

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Hum.. Iromo's favorite?
Let me think...
Actually he likes all kinds of food.
He is not picky about food.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
嗯...伊罗莫喜欢吃什么？
让我想想...
其实他什么食物都喜欢。
他对食物并不挑剔。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
When he went out with friends,
he spent all his pocket money,
but I don't know what he has been eating.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
以前他出去和朋友玩的时候，
总是把零花钱花光，
但我不知道他都吃了些什么。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Oh, why don't you ask Iromo's friend?
I think he would know about his favorite food.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
哦，你为什么不问问伊罗莫的朋友呢？
我想他应该知道伊罗莫喜欢吃什么。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Hum.. Iromo's favorite?
Let me think...
Actually he likes all kinds of food.
He is not picky about food.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
嗯...伊罗莫喜欢吃什么？
让我想想...
其实他什么食物都喜欢。
他对食物并不挑剔。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
When he went out with friends,
he spent all his pocket money,
but I don't know what he has been eating.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
以前他出去和朋友玩的时候，
总是把零花钱花光，
但我不知道他都吃了些什么。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Oh, why don't you ask Iromo's friend?
I think he would know about his favorite food.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
哦，你为什么不问问伊罗莫的朋友呢？
我想他应该知道伊罗莫喜欢吃什么。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
This little boy is my son, Iromo.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
这个小男孩就是我的儿子，伊罗莫。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
He used to go out all the time.
He loved playing outside with friends.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
他以前总是到处跑。
他喜欢和朋友们在外面玩。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
But, somehow...
he doesn't go out anymore.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
但是，不知为什么...
他再也不出去了。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
I am so worried about him...
What happened to him..?
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
我好担心他...
他到底怎么了..？

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Iromo? He used to like ^FF0000Monster's Feed^000000 and ^FF0000Red Potion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
伊罗莫？他以前喜欢^FF0000魔物饲料^000000和^FF0000红色药水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Oh ya and one more thing~!
I like Bananas. Haha.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
哦对了，还有一件事~！
我喜欢香蕉。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
......

[Little Boy]
Yummy! Banana is always delicious!
Bananas are the best fruits ever!
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
好吃！香蕉总是很美味！
香蕉是最好吃的水果！

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Thanks for the Banana...
Now I can think about
what Iromo likes to eat.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
谢谢你的香蕉...
现在我可以想想
伊罗莫喜欢吃什么了。

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
He used to like junk food.
You know, cheap and weird tasting snacks...
So he had to hide when he had them.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
他以前喜欢吃垃圾食品。
就是那种便宜又难吃的零食...
所以他吃的时候都要躲起来。

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
